data_output.description: The fixed training command must emit predictions_valid.npz containing exactly two arrays: row_ids and scores. row_ids must be int64 identifiers in canonical validation row order, and scores must be finite one-dimensional long_view-head predictions with exactly one score per validation row. The evaluator alone loads validation ground truth.

model_input.description: Model receives encoded impression features in the existing two-dimensional integer matrix format, training long_view labels, and training-only is_click labels aligned row-for-row. It optimizes the shared factorization-machine representation with long_view BCE plus 0.2 times is_click BCE, while predict(features) returns only long_view-head logits in input row order. No validation or test labels may enter fitting, early stopping, or prediction.
